discovery.note: Washington's SEPA Register: every SEPA and NEPA record filed with the Department of Ecology since 2000, statewide, published on data.wa.gov (Socrata). Registered because it is the highest coverage-per-hour western source found in the 2026-09-02 scan: one config covers a whole state, where the eastern equivalent is one config per county. The 4x4 resource id is resolved by discover_socrata_dataset.py in CI rather than pinned by hand. The where clause below is still a guess at the column names, and it is wrong: the weekly run on 2026-09-08 resolved the dataset correctly and then took HTTP 400 from Socrata, because a $where naming a column the dataset does not have is rejected outright. As of 2026-09-09 that is no longer a job failure -- discover_socrata_dataset.py records the dataset's columns and fetch_permits.py checks this clause against them first, so a mismatch skips cleanly and prints the real column names. Read them out of data/socrata_discovery_wa_sepa.md after the next run and the fix is one edit here.
